ai.seo_question: What happens to the sky on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Al-Mursalat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Naba (78:19) is often interpreted as the literal opening of the celestial realms to witness the final reckoning, reflecting the cosmic upheaval described in hadiths regarding the Day of Judgment. The 'gates' signify the structured manifestation of divine justice and the distinct entry points for different classes of souls, emphasizing the tangible reality of the Hereafter.
